components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bordered prominent action for the one affirmative control in a pane.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #007AFF; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 13px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0066D6; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered default action used across Settings.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14); border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; font: 500 13px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; padding: 5px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F2F2F2; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Row Button
components.description: The app's default chrome button: borderless, 6% hover fill, 6 px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { appearance: none; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #1D1D1F; font: 500 13px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; padding: 7px 10px; text-align: left; width: 100%; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: background 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost-glyph { font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Composer Field
components.description: Floating 18 pt card on the control surface with a shadow and no border.
components.html: Ask DynaMoE anything... (Enter to send)
components.css: .ds-composer { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14); padding: 12px 14px; min-height: 44px; } .ds-composer-placeholder { color: #8E8E93; font: 400 14px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; }

components.name: User Message Bubble
components.description: Violet wash at 18% over the window surface, 14 pt radius, right-aligned.
components.html: The capital of France is
components.css: .ds-bubble-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-bubble-user { background: rgba(175, 82, 222, 0.18); color: #1D1D1F; font: 400 14px/20px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 16px; max-width: 60ch; }

components.name: Sidebar Session Row
components.description: Flat row; selected state is a 12% violet fill, hover 6% primary.
components.html:
Named the launch plan
Qwen repack notes
components.css: .ds-nav-row { border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; color: #1D1D1F; font: 500 12px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-nav-row + .ds-nav-row { margin-top: 2px; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); } .ds-nav-row-selected { background: rgba(175, 82, 222, 0.12); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Capsule badge whose tint is the state: green success, indigo running, orange approval, red error.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 6px; font: 700 9.5px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-success { color: #34C759; background: rgba(52, 199, 89, 0.12); } .ds-badge-running { color: #5856D6; background: rgba(88, 86, 214, 0.12); }

components.name: Settings Card
components.description: System-Settings-style grouped inset card: no border, faint fill, continuous 10 pt corners.
components.css: .ds-settings-card { background: #F8F8F8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 14px; } .ds-settings-card-header { margin: 0 0 6px 8px; color: #1D1D1F; font: 600 12.5px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-settings-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); } .ds-settings-row:first-of-type { border-top: none; } .ds-settings-row-title { color: #1D1D1F; font: 400 13px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-settings-row-value { color: #6E6E73; font: 400 12px 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: 8 pt card with a header bar, divider, and a monospaced canvas on the text surface.
components.css: .ds-code { border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-code-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 7px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-code-lang { color: #6E6E73; font: 700 11px 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-code-copy { color: #6E6E73; font: 500 10px -apple-system, 'SF Pro', sans-serif; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-code-body { margin: 0; padding: 12px; color: #1D1D1F; font: 400 12.5px/17px 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Tool Step Badge
components.description: Timeline step: 6 pt status dot, mono step label, tinted pill with matching stroke.
components.css: .ds-step { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; color: #1D1D1F; font: 600 10.5px 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; background: rgba(52, 199, 89, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(52, 199, 89, 0.2); } .ds-step-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #34C759; }

narrative.overview: DynaMoE looks like equipment that is running something: dense rows of small type, live numbers in monospaced figures, and a status light that changes color while the machine works. The interface is not a stage for the model; it is the panel you watch the model through. Density is the aesthetic, and restraint is how it stays readable - panels, hairlines, and system surfaces carry the structure, while one violet signal marks identity and activity.
keyCharacteristics: Small type (9-13 pt) at almost every size, with a single 22 pt display moment.
Flat system surfaces separated by 1 px translucent strokes, not shadows.
One violet-to-indigo signal gradient, reserved for identity marks.
State colors (green, orange, red, indigo, violet) that always mean something.
Radii that step with containment: 18 floating, 14 bubble, 10 card, 8 control, 6 row.

rules.name: The Provisional Palette Rule
rules.body: The palette is scheduled for replacement from the DRP and DynaMoE websites. Do not mint new colors from it or extend violet into a new component; use the existing tier that already means what you need, or use a system semantic color.

rules.name: The Signal-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Violet identifies DynaMoE or marks that it is working. It is never a background wash for a section, a heading color, or a hover state on neutral chrome.

rules.name: The Status Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Green means success or generating, orange means warning, attention, or Turbo Mode, red means failure, indigo means running, violet means withheld or idle. A status color always carries a state; a decorative accent never borrows one.

rules.name: The Small-Type Rule
rules.body: UI chrome lives between 9 and 13 pt. Nothing above 16.5 pt appears more than once per surface, and only as a display moment.

rules.name: The Zoom-Not-Dynamic-Type Rule
rules.body: Type scales through the app zoom (0.6-2.5 in 0.15 steps, persisted), never through per-view size variants. Every custom size is written as max(floor, base * zoomScale) so text never falls below its legibility floor; new text must do the same.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Measured Rule
rules.body: Any number the user might compare (tok/s, TTFT, GB, tokens, tau, durations) is monospaced. Prose numbers are not.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a stroke, not a shadow. Inside the window, use primary.opacity(0.06-0.2) at 1 px; reserve every shadow for elements that leave the surface plane.

dos: Do draw surfaces from AppKit semantic colors first; the only literal neutrals are the two Settings fills.
Do write custom type as max(floor, base * zoomScale) so the 0.6 zoom floor never clips.
Do use the status vocabulary for status and nothing else.
Do keep the composer, cards, and code blocks inside the 6/8/10/14/18 radius ladder.
Do prefer a 1 px stroke or a tonal fill over a shadow for separation.
Do lean on stock macOS chrome - bordered buttons, menus, pickers - for new settings surfaces; the restrained direction wins ties.
donts: Don't introduce new hues, gradients, or violet opacity tiers; the palette is provisional and awaiting the site-derived rebrand.
Don't put the violet-to-indigo gradient on chrome; it belongs to identity marks (avatar, welcome mark, blockquote rail, agent indicator).
Don't animate longer than 0.2 s for state changes; 0.85 s is reserved for the streaming pace pulse.
Don't use Dynamic Type APIs or hardcoded point sizes that ignore the zoom manager.
Don't use SF Symbols larger than 30 pt outside the single display moment.
